name: Mairsil
description: Jodah's nemesis whose mind is in the ruby ring combined with Lim-Dul.

description_citations.text: "The Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil locks Ith in Barl's Cage and takes over leadership of the Conclave while draining Ith's magic.
timeline.quote: Ith's jailer Mairsil took over the role as the leader of the Conclave

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The enraged Ith kills Mairsil, turns Barl into a Rag Man, drives the mages away and razes the school.
timeline.quote: Mairsil was killed, Barl was turned into a Rag Man

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ring grants Lim-Dûl great power; he builds Tresserhorn and becomes a necromancer, with Leshrac and Mairsil manipulating him.
timeline.quote: The ring granted him incredible powers that not only allowed him to survive the blizzard but also to become a powerful necromancer.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the last battle, Lim-Dûl faces Jodah under Mairsil's control, and Leshrac cuts off Lim-Dûl's hand and tears him apart.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl was turned into a living ball of raw flesh that Leshrac took with him off-plane

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah discovers Mairsil has usurped the Conclave from Lord Ith and keeps him caged to drain his powers.
timeline.quote: Mairsil has usurped control of the Conclave from its founder, Lord Ith

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima free Ith, who kills Mairsil and then is restored by seeing his reflection in Jodah's mirror.
timeline.quote: The insane wizard kills Mairsil

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle Jaya defeats Chaeska with an unsummon and claims Lim-Dûl's severed hand, unaware it bears Mairsil's ring.
timeline.quote: Jaya was successful in her battle and later claimed Lim-Dûl's severed hand as a battle trophy

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wearing the ruby ring, Jaya is possessed by Mairsil and cuts Jodah's throat, but Jodah survives and shatters his mirror in her face.
timeline.quote: She cut Jodah's throat, using his blood to revive the Phyrexian war beasts.

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Her planeswalker spark flares, Jaya erases Mairsil's presence and destroys the war beasts, then helps seal the pit and relocate the school.
timeline.quote: Jaya's planeswalker spark flared.

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle, Jodah duels Lim-Dûl, until Leshrac cuts off Dûl's hand and takes him to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Leshrac took him to Phyrexia to be recreated

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Soldev, Jaya, vessel of Mairsil/Dûl, stabs Jodah, and the Adnates use his blood to activate the War Beasts, which level Soldev and the School of the Unseen.
timeline.quote: Jaya stabbed Jodah fatally, revealing that she had been the new vessel of Mairsil/Dûl all along

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah smashes his mirror in Jaya's face, burning away Mairsil and Lim-Dûl and triggering Jaya's spark.
timeline.quote: smashed his mirror in Jaya's face

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil's ring coerces Jaya into picking it up; the possessed Jaya stabs Jodah at Soldev and destroys Soldev and the School of the Unseen, until Jaya ascends and expels the minds.
timeline.quote: Jaya ascended and removed the minds of Lim-Dûl and Mairsil from herself.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil usurps his teacher Ith's position and steals the Wand of Ith.
timeline.quote: When Mairsil usurped his teacher's position, he stole the wand and used it for himself.

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine (artifact)", section "Wand of Ith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil uses the wand to drain Primata Delphine's defenses and stabs her to death during her assault on the Conclave.
timeline.quote: draining away her magical defenses and then stabbing her to death

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine (artifact)", section "Wand of Ith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah fights Lim-Dûl, revealed to be a blend of himself and Mairsil the Pretender; Lim-Dûl summons Leshrac, who rips him apart and takes him to the rogue plane.
timeline.quote: Leshrac rips the necromancer to shreds but keeps him alive during it all

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the last battle against Lim-Dul, Leshrac cuts off the necromancer's hand and the ruby ring holding Mairsil/Dul's mind seeks a new host.
timeline.quote: just after Leshrac has cut off the necromancer's hand

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah chooses to save his friend over his school; he smashes the mirror into Jaya's face and she ascends as a planeswalker, purging Dul and Mairsil.
timeline.quote: she indeed ascends, purging Dûl and Mairsil from her mind

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barl's Cage holds Lord Ith for a dozen years until Mairsil's power weakens.
timeline.quote: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith

citation.text: Barl's Cage (Masters Edition III, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barl and Mairsil imprison Lord Ith in Barl's Cage for fifteen-odd years.
timeline.quote: Barl and Mairsil imprisoned Lord Ith , the founder, in Barl's Cage

citation.text: "Barl", section "Imprisoning Ith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barl interviews Jodah, and Mairsil recognizes Jarsyl's name and assigns Jodah to the library.
timeline.quote: Mairsil told Barl that Jodah was to work in the library.

citation.text: "Barl", section "Meeting with Jodah". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barl suspects Sima of being from the City of Shadows and reports to Mairsil.
timeline.quote: Barl suspected that she was from the City of Shadows

citation.text: "Barl", section "The duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil and Barl plot to make Jodah kill Sima in a proxy duel, and Barl prepares both mages.
timeline.quote: The idea was to get Jodah to kill Sima.

citation.text: "Barl", section "The duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima duel and Jodah wins, and Mairsil goes to finish Sima.
timeline.quote: Three days later, Jodah and Sima clashed.

citation.text: "Barl", section "The duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal attacks the Conclave and Barl organizes the counter-attack, killing one of its members.
timeline.quote: Barl organized the counter-attack.

citation.text: "Barl", section "The attack". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Fall of the Conclave and Mairsil's death, it is revealed that Barl created Ith's replacement Rag Man and received his punishment.
timeline.quote: The new Rag Man turned out to be created by none other than Barl.

citation.text: "Barl", section "Barl's fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah is traded to the Rag Man and taken to the Conclave of Mages, where he passes Mairsil's test.
timeline.quote: Jodah succeeded in the test that Mairsil , the ruler of the Conclave, had set for him

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During a Church of Tal assault Jodah frees Ith, who rampages and kills Mairsil and the Rag Man, then is calmed by Jodah's mirror.
timeline.quote: Ith, who had been driven insane by his time over the Pit, go into a murderous rampage that resulted in the death of Mairsil and the Rag Man

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah figures out the portal spell but uses white mana, so it fails; he later learns it needs black mana and never completes it.
timeline.quote: but mistakenly used white mana instead of black, causing the spell to fail

citation.text: "Jarsyl", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil and Barl imprison Ith in the cage.
timeline.quote: Mairsil and Barl imprisoned Ith there

citation.text: "Barl's Cage", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Delphine leads an assault on the Conclave of Mages and is killed by Mairsil with the Wand of Ith.
timeline.quote: Mairsil drained all of Delphine's magical defenses, and then stabbed her in the chest, killing her

citation.text: "Delphine", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil drains Delphine's wards with the Wand of Ith, stabs her to death and burns her corpse.
timeline.quote: he drained her wards with the Wand of Ith and then stabbed her to death, setting fire to her corpse.

citation.work: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
citation.text: "Fall of the Conclave of Mages", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah redirects Ith's burning ray to set Mairsil on fire and restores Ith's sanity with the mirror.
timeline.quote: Jodah then used the mirror to restore Ith's sanity.

citation.work: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
citation.text: "Fall of the Conclave of Mages", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil imprisons Ith in Barl's Cage for a dozen years, siphoning his mana while Ith slides into madness.
timeline.quote: Ith was imprisoned in Barl's Cage for a dozen years by Mairsil, the Pretender .

citation.text: "Ith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ith attacks the Conclave and kills Mairsil before Jodah restores his sanity with the mirror.
timeline.quote: An enraged Ith attacked the Conclave and killed Mairsil before Jodah used his mirror to restore his sanity.

citation.text: "Ith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil usurps Lord Ith and imprisons him in Barl's Cage.
timeline.quote: Lord Ith was the ruler of the Conclave until Mairsil usurped his power

citation.text: "Mairsil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Church of Tal army attacks the Conclave; Mairsil drains Primata Delphine's defenses with the Wand of Ith and stabs her to death.
timeline.quote: after draining away her magical defenses with the

citation.text: "Mairsil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jodah frees Ith, who destroys Mairsil before Jodah cures his mind.
timeline.quote: An enraged Ith destroyed Mairsil before Jodah cured his mind.

citation.text: "Mairsil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil's essence survives in a ruby ring for 2,000 years.
timeline.quote: his essence survived for the next 2,000 years

citation.text: "Mairsil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac cuts off Lim-Dul's hand with the ring before Mairsil can take control.
timeline.quote: Leshrac, seeking extra power himself, cut off the necromancer's hand with the ring.

citation.text: "Mairsil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mairsil poisons Jaya Ballard's mind to make her betray Jodah, but Jodah ignites her spark and her ascension eradicates Mairsil's soul within her.
timeline.quote: Jaya's ascension , and the energies it released, eradicated all traces of Mairsil's soul within her.

citation.text: "Mairsil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
